issuer: the Ministry of Internal Affairs' Directorate General for Driving Licences and Registrations (Direcția Generală Permise de Conducere și Înmatriculări, DGPCI), through the county community public services for driving licences and vehicle registration
note: Read 2026-10-30. DGPCI's own site (dgpci.mai.gov.ro, rendered in a browser; its pages are drawn by script): its press release on updated charges says that from 15 September 2026 the charge for issuing a driving licence is 139 lei (the exam fee and medical certificate aren't held). The age and the term: Government Emergency Ordinance 1/2024 (published in Monitorul Oficial no. 48 of 18 January 2024) amending Emergency Ordinance 195/2002 on traffic on public roads, read in the copy of its text the National Union of Road Hauliers of Romania (UNTRR) publishes, because the state's legislation portal (legislatie.just.ro, which DGPCI's legal-basis page links for OUG 195/2002) didn't answer from here: art. 20(4)(b) gives 18 full years for categories A2, B, BE, C1, C1E, Tr and Tr1, and art. 24(5)(b) 10 years for licences issued for categories AM, A1, A2, A, B, B1, BE and Tr1. A proposal reported in the press to lengthen that term to 15 years wasn't found enacted (the consolidated text couldn't be read here), so the 10 years stand as OUG 1/2024 set them. No identity card is held (the identity card is the ids engine's); no exchange list was read.

sources.title: DGPCI, Actualizarea tarifelor pentru emiterea permisului de conducere, a certificatului de înmatriculare și a autorizației de circulație provizorie
sources.said: Începând cu data de 15.09.2026, tarifele actualizate pentru emiterea permisului de conducere, a certificatului de înmatriculare și a autorizației de circulație provizorie vor fi următoarele: ... permis de conducere – 139 lei ... Serviciu Public Comunitar Regim Permise de Conducere și Înmatriculare a Vehiculelor teritorial
